objective: Test whether packed layer-0 dense-MLP execution introduces the request-order-dependent state first observed at the layer-1 GDN boundary.

rationale.established_left_boundary: R108 proved layer-0 request-isolated GDN normalized/projected rows are invariant across packed request order.
rationale.established_right_boundary: R108 proved layer-1 GDN normalized rows vary across packed request order.
rationale.negative_control: R109 proved the existing packed-serial outer RMSNorm treatment is insufficient.
rationale.remaining_layer0_operation: The dense MLP between post-attention normalization and the returned layer-0 hidden state.

treatment.single_request: Call the unchanged loaded MLP once on the original tensor.
treatment.pure_multi_request_prefill: Read live GDNAttentionMetadata boundaries inside an opaque custom op, call the unchanged loaded MLP independently for each request, and concatenate in scheduler order.
treatment.decode_or_mixed_phase: Call the unchanged loaded MLP once.

mandatory_gates.semantic_source: Require the custom-op call inside Qwen3NextDecoderLayer.forward, exactly one registration, and the layer-0/linear-attention guard.
mandatory_gates.runtime_execution: Require distinct single-request-control and split-per-request markers before interpreting outputs.
mandatory_gates.identity: C1 must remain exact; every request must return 128 tokens with cached_tokens=0.
mandatory_gates.abort: If warm c1 is not exact, invalidate immediately without c2 interpretation.

workload.warmup: One c1 and two c2 repeats.
workload.qualification: Three c1 and twenty c2 repeats after warmup.

decision.pass: Remove the inherited R108 projection trace/isolation treatment in a factorial follow-up, then run fresh-server realistic quality and performance qualification on a clean boot.
decision.fail: Reject layer-0 MLP request packing as sufficient and move to the residual/consumer boundary without weakening output identity.

resource_boundary: Use 12 GiB container RAM and 16 GiB RAM-plus-swap; no reboot or GPU reset.
reporting_boundary: Causal diagnostic only. The current boot contains earlier GPU resets; no public speed, README, website, or LocalMaxxing update.
